items.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the historical cumulative price or the TWAP window, so the intended 'derived from historical cumulative price data' relation cannot be expressed numerically; only the qualitative guard-pass outcome is bound.
No concrete amounts, percentages, or numeric bounds for the economic loss are given, so the loss is represented only as a Boolean occurrence.
The report does not give a numeric definition of the historical TWAP versus spot price relation, so the historical-derivation requirement is represented as a grounded Boolean.
